title: Immaculate Constellation hub at Schriever Air Force Base

tellings.quote: towards uh Shrivever Air Force Base in Colorado as being at least one hub of of this program.

plain: A secret program called Immaculate Constellation has at least one hub at Schriever Air Force Base in Colorado, says Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who has come forward as a whistleblower. He tells Michels that a briefing on the program's capabilities points toward the base. If true, it would put a hidden program at a known military site.
